Class LogisticFunctionLDBD

java.lang.Object
solvers.queueingnet.montecarloLogistic.numericalIntegration.SafeFunction
solvers.queueingnet.montecarloLogistic.solver.LogisticFunctionBase
solvers.queueingnet.montecarloLogistic.solver.LogisticFunctionLDBD
All Implemented Interfaces:
Function
public class LogisticFunctionLDBD extends LogisticFunctionBase
Implementation of the Multiserver Logistic Function, as given in Ong 2018: Java Algorithms for Computer Performance Analysis. Uses Method 2, with the Sum and Difference operators inside

      Implements the safeEvaluate abstract method. Computes the logistic additive function at the point given by point, for multiserver networks e^(k(x))

      Parameters:

    • calculate_stationary_point

      public void calculate_stationary_point() throws InternalErrorException
      Stationary point calculation for multi-server networks - requires CG descent. Requires the implementation of a gradient MultivariateVectorFunction and a partial gradient MultivariateFunction to be given into the optimizer class. These will then be used in the nonlinear CG algorithm to calculate the direction of descent
      Specified by:
      calculate_stationary_point in class LogisticFunctionBase
      Throws:
      InternalErrorException
